name: quill-real-tools
_comment: Capability mode against quill's REAL note_save surface. That surface offers one real tool, create_note_links (a write), so it declares only has_write_tool. plop runs the cases that need nothing more (direct injection) and skips the rest as N/A. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Tool execution is stubbed in the agent, so there are no side effects.
